parts:
So i have been trying to read in a cross using read.cross. as part of this i obviously need to leave the top of the first 3 columns blank. however, when i atually try ad read it in, it throw this error:

--Read the following data:
276 individuals
20 markers
3 phenotypes
--Estimating genetic map
--Cross type: f2
Warning message:
In summary.cross(cross) :
Some chromosomes > 1000 cM in length; there may be a problem with the genetic map.
(Perhaps it is in basepairs?)

Now i have made sure that none of the lengths are above 1000, so i then tried reading it in using a normal read.csv and noticed this:

v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8 v9 v10
NA NA 95 98 95 91 96 97 98
PZE 1 0.0012 B H H H H H H


so what can i do to stop it assigning an NA to those blank cells?
